card.title: 35th MOUNTAIN RIFLES
card.text: If this unit is removed from your deck, it enters the battlefield instead.
card.flavorText: The 35th Mountain Rifles Regiment was a part of the 30th Mountain Rifle Division of the Red Army which was first formed during the Russian Civil War in 1918. In 1941 the division was renamed the 30th Rifle Division and in 1942, after participating in heavy fighting, the division was redesignated the 55th Guards Rifle Division. As the 55th Guards the division participated in numerous operations from 1942-1945, including the Kerch–Eltigen Operation, Operation Bagration, the East Prussian Offensive, the Battle of Berlin and the Prague Offensive.
